      <h1>Consequential Side-Effect Register: What Can Our Agents Actually Do To Us?</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">A signed register of every consequential agent-reachable side effect, its reversal cost and current enforcement point — the org's agent blast-radius baseline.</p>
    </div>

      <b>WS-16-consequential-effect-register</b><br>
